name: codex-usage-monitor
description: Show Codex usage in Desktop, CLI, and a native macOS menu bar app.

interface.shortDescription: Usage and API-equivalent cost across Codex.
interface.longDescription: Codex Usage Monitor reads local Codex session JSONL logs and renders usage in Codex Desktop, the CLI, and a native bilingual macOS menu bar app. It never sends telemetry and uses only local files.
interface.defaultPrompt: Show my current Codex CLI usage.
